kebab_example: aliyun servicecatalog create-product-version --product-version-name 1.0 --template-type RosTerraformTemplate --template-url oss://servicecatalog-cn-hangzhou/1466115886170000/terraform/template/tpl-bp1217we230000/template.json --product-id prod-bp18r7q1270000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateProductVersion

parameters.help_en:
The name of the product version.

The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
产品版本名称。

长度为1~128个字符
parameters.name: product_version_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the product template. Valid values:

RosTerraformTemplate: the Terraform template that is supported by Resource Orchestration Service (ROS).

RosStandardTemplate: the standard ROS template
parameters.help_zh:
产品模板类型。取值：

RosTerraformTemplate：表示阿里云资源编排服务（ROS）支持的Terraform模板。
RosStandardTemplate：表示阿里云资源编排服务（ROS）标准模板
parameters.name: template_type

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the template.

For more information about how to obtain the URL of a template, see [CreateTemplate](~~CreateTemplate~~)
parameters.help_zh:
模板的URL地址。

获取模板URL地址的方法，请参见[CreateTemplate](~~CreateTemplate~~)
parameters.name: template_url

parameters.example: This is a product version description.
parameters.help_en:
The description of the product version.

The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
产品版本描述。

长度为1~128个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The recommendation information. Valid values:

Default: No recommendation information is provided. This is the default value.

Recommended: the recommendation version.

Latest: the latest version.

Deprecated: the version that is about to be discontinued
parameters.help_zh:
推荐信息。取值：

Default（默认值）：无。
Recommended：稳定版。
Latest：最新版。
Deprecated：将废弃
parameters.name: guidance

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the product version is active. Valid values:

true: The product version is active. This is the default value.

false: The product version is inactive
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用。取值：

true（默认值）：启用。
false：禁用
parameters.name: active

parameters.help_en: The ID of the product to which the product version belongs
parameters.name: product_id

ProductVersionId.description_en: The ID of the product version
